plan: Model the session as one dictionary with exactly the four contract keys, cloned from a frozen initial template so begin/abandon reset cleanly
Copy appointments into fresh {id, label} dicts at construction, preserving input order, with an id set for validation
Dispatch handle() through a type-to-method table where every handler fully validates before mutating, so invalid actions never corrupt accepted data
Centralize screen construction in one builder enforcing: choices exactly when prompt is 'Choose appointment', messages default empty, error screens prefix 'Error:' and reflect unchanged state
Derive prompts from a single next-unmet-step function (Confirm contact -> Choose appointment -> Review and complete) shared by contact answers and corrections
Implement run_once with duck-typed injected action_source/screen_sink so unittest fakes plug in, raising RuntimeError before either is called if missing
mechanisms: single mutable session dictionary reset from a frozen initial template
constructor-time defensive copy of appointments plus id set for membership validation
action-type dispatch table with guard-first (validate-then-mutate) handlers
centralized screen builder enforcing prompt/choices/messages invariants
Error:-prefixed non-raising error screens built from unchanged state
dependency-injected duck-typed action source and screen sink with precondition RuntimeError in run_once
